_note: Retell built-in 'Call Transfer' functions. Replace placeholder numbers with real E.164 numbers in the Retell dashboard.

functions.name: transfer_billing
functions.description: Transfer the caller to the billing specialist after they give verbal consent (billing dispute, charge, double charge).

functions.name: transfer_tech
functions.description: Transfer the caller to technical support after they give verbal consent (server failure, technical outage).

functions.name: transfer_crisis
functions.description: Use immediately in emergencies (self-harm, medical emergency, physical danger). No consent needed.
